note: Gold set (150 lines) for comparing decision models with motion-engine's real questions. Each channel lists every acceptable answer; 'none' means no visible action. Lines are the avatar's unless speaker is 'user' (then judged as the listening avatar's reaction: empathy, not a copy of the person's emotion); 'previous' is the line before, given as context. Includes the 40 lines of gold.json; one fix: 'Ay, me da un poco de vergüenza decirlo.' had look_down under head (it is an expression), so look_down moved to expression and head is ['none']. Fully neutral lines (facts, plain questions) accept only 'none' on all channels; hard negatives mention a gesture word without doing it (thumbs up, clapping, pointing) or use sarcasm ('Just perfect', 'Genial').
